name: blabla-link
description: Link your BlaBlaLink account to your Discord account
prefixOnly: Use /blabla-link to link your BlaBlaLink account.
alreadyLinked: Your Discord account is already linked to BlaBlaLink user **{{id}}**. Use /blabla-relink to change methods or /blabla-unlink to unlink.
selectRegionDesc:
Choose your BlaBlaLink server region to get started.

**🌍 Global** — JP / KR / NA / SEA / Global
**🌏 HK/MC/TW** — Hong Kong / Macau / Taiwan
chooseMethod:
**Link Account — {{emoji}} {{region}}**

Choose how you want to link your BlaBlaLink account:

**By User ID** — Paste your BlaBlaLink user ID and verify via [profile signature]({{url}}).
**By Cookie** — Paste your browser cookies from BlaBlaLink.
noVerification: No pending verification. Start over with /blabla-link.
timeExpired: Time expired. Please start over with /blabla-link.
fetchProfileFailed: Could not fetch your BlaBlaLink profile. Please try again later.
phraseNotFound:
The phrase wasn't found in your BlaBlaLink signature yet.
Wait 1-2 minutes and click the button again.
verified: ✅ Verification successful! Your Discord account is now linked to **{{username}}**.
invalidUserId: Invalid user ID. Please enter the numeric ID from your BlaBlaLink profile.
accountNotFound: Could not find a BlaBlaLink account with that ID. Double-check your user ID and try again.
bothRequired: Both User ID and Auth Token are required.
invalidCredentials: Could not validate these credentials. Make sure the values are correct and you're still logged in on BlaBlaLink.
linkedCookie: ✅ Successfully linked to **{{username}}** via cookies! Your session will be automatically refreshed.
verifyFound:
✅ Found **{{username}}**!

To verify ownership, put this phrase in your [BlaBlaLink signature]({{url}}), then click check:
**{{phrase}}**

Then click the button below to check.
_This verification will expire <t:{{expiry}}:R>._

cookieInstructions.pcDesc:
Follow these steps to get your BlaBlaLink cookies.

**Step 1** — Go to **https://www.blablalink.com** in your browser and make sure you're logged in.

**Step 2** — Press **F12** (or right-click → Inspect) to open Developer Tools.

**Step 3** — Go to the **Application** tab (or **Storage** on some browsers).

**Step 4** — On the left, expand **Cookies** and click **https://www.blablalink.com**.

**Step 5** — Click the **Insert Cookies** button below and copy the **game_openid** and **game_token** values.
cookieInstructions.androidDesc:
Follow these steps to get your BlaBlaLink cookies from an Android device.

**Step 1** — Open **Chrome** on your Android device, go to **https://www.blablalink.com**, and log in.

**Step 2** — In the address bar, type or paste this:
```js
javascript:prompt('',document.cookie)
```
> ⚠️ If Chrome removes the `javascript:` prefix, save it as a bookmark and open it while on BlaBlaLink.

**Step 3** — Copy the text that appears in the popup.

**Step 4** — Click the **Insert Cookies** button below and paste the result.
